THE SUMMER EE GLOW-UP  /  VOL. 3

Volume three. Fourteen more of the best, and still zero overlap
with the first two lists.
The first two guides covered the foundations and the deeper cuts. This one is about
specializing: the channels, courses, and tools that take you from a capable student
to someone with a real lane. Same format. Every resource has how to use it, the job
it maps to, and a link. Tap any name to open it.

Fourteen options now, so the rule matters more, not less. Do not try to
do all of them. Pick three that point at the same job and go deep. A
checklist is not a skill.

PICK YOUR LANE
Three lanes again. Pick one set of three. The reference, IoT, safety, Q and A, and
project picks ride along with any lane.
You want to design, build, and fab real hardware.
Outcome: you take a circuit from idea to a fabricated board.
You want to understand logic, chips, and firmware.
Outcome: you build logic, see how a CPU works, and write the firmware on top.
You want the math, signals, and control to click.
Outcome: you handle the math and control that everything else is built on.
